hypothesis: candidate_pool: persistent positive overnight repricing with muted intraday follow-through may identify liquid stocks where institutional demand accumulates outside regular hours without signal-day chase.

post_run_reflection.forbidden_near_neighbor_retry: Do not retry this family by only changing 10-day lookback, thresholds, cooldown, hold days, or daily top-N on the same frozen windows.
post_run_reflection.new_evidence_required: A retry needs materially new PIT evidence, such as auction or pre-market breadth data, forward replacement-value rows, or a production-visible event field explaining why overnight demand should persist.
post_run_reflection.why_result_happened: The signal likely relabeled ordinary momentum or overnight gap mean reversion instead of finding durable absorption. Any window regression, drawdown drift, or concentration failure means the multi-day overnight decomposition did not add robust replacement value beyond existing accepted OHLCV sleeves.

pre_run_questions.1_alpha_hypothesis: candidate_pool alpha: persistent overnight repricing with muted intraday action may identify demand absorbed outside regular hours while avoiding single-day gap chase.

2_history_check.exp-20260601-009: Only a proposed/read-only overnight-vs-intraday component mean card; no runner or Gate 1-4 result exists.
2_history_check.exp-20260608-013: Accepted OHLCV compression/absorption is a comparator; this test is candidate-pool expansion, not a parameter retry.
2_history_check.exp-20260609-002/004: Gap-and-hold style attempts were single-event gap tests and failed; this test uses a multi-day decomposition and caps signal-day chase.

pre_run_questions.4_acceptance_standard: Same three canonical windows. Aggregate EV/PnL must be positive; no EV/PnL regression window; at least 20 paper trades across all 3 windows; survival >=5%; drawdown drift <=0.5pp; concentration pass. Positive replay-only output is a lead, not production acceptance, until shared parity exists.

prediction.confidence_reason: Prior overnight/intraday work was only proposed/read-only and broad OHLCV pools often fail old_thin, but this uses PIT OHLCV and a distinct multi-day overnight-minus-intraday structure instead of single gap chasing.

production_impact.parity_note: This experiment changes no production code. A positive result is only a replay lead until a shared default-off helper computes the same overnight/intraday decomposition, liquidity gates, same-ticker core overlap exclusion, cooldown, next-open paper entry, 10-trading-day exit, costs, and concentration controls in both historical replay and the daily production snapshot.
